## d3 · Morning Reminders
Every day at 8 AM (Pakistan time): d0 lists the bookings that need a reminder (tomorrow's, plus today's booked after yesterday's run; not cancelled, not already sent) and a "Needs attention" email for any row that can't get one, naming the row and what's wrong. That email also lists every upcoming booking that falls on a day its doctor is away (Closures), every morning until it's moved or cancelled. Patients are never emailed about it automatically.

Send Emails sends them all and keeps going if one fails. Stamp writes `Sent … PKT` or `Failed … PKT: reason` into the reminder column. Failed ones are retried the next morning; sent ones never repeat.

To test: in Due Reminders set data to {{ { test_now: '2026-10-19 08:00' } }}, run, then set it back to {{ {} }}.

### Keep Check Sends below Stamp
n8n runs the top branch first, so the stamps are saved before Check Sends looks. If any email failed, Check Sends stops the run with the names, and e0 emails you.
